title: UserResponseDTO
description: The response object representing a user in the contact center.

organizationId.description: ID of the contact center organization. This field is required for all bulk save operations.

id.description: ID of this contact center resource. It should not be specified when creating a new resource. However, it is mandatory when updating a resource.

version.description: The version of this resource. For a newly created resource, it will be 0 unless specified otherwise.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

workPhone.description: The work phone number of the user.

mobile.description: The mobile phone number of the user.

timezone.description: (Optional) The time zone that you provision for your enterprise.

xspVersion.description: (Optional) Used to subscribe for recording events.

subscriptionId.description: (Optional) Used to subscribe for recording events.

userProfileId.description: Identifier for an user profile which a Contact Center administrator has configured.

userProfileType.description: Type of the user profile associated to this user. This is an optional response parameter based on the query parameter includeUserProfileType.

contactCenterEnabled.description: The setting is for accessing Desktop to handle customer requests.

siteId.description: Details of site which a Contact Center administrator has configured for the user.

siteName.description: site name that user is associated with

teamIds.description:
Specify the teams id which got assigned to this user. 
Note: You can’t assign this profile to a capacity-based team.

items.description:
Specify the teams id which got assigned to this user. 
Note: You can’t assign this profile to a capacity-based team.

skillProfileId.description: (Optional) If your enterprise uses the optional Skills-Based Routing feature, This profile overrides any skill profile at the team level that is associated with the agent

agentProfileId.description: Identifier for a Desktop Profile which is a group of permissions and Agent Desktop behaviors that you assign to specific users.

multimediaProfileId.description: (Optional) If your organization administrator enables Multimedia for your enterprise, you can select a multimedia profile for this team.

deafultDialledNumber.description: (Optional) The dial number of the agent.

externalIdentifier.description: (Optional) Agent identification details, such as the employee number.

active.description: Specify whether the user is active or not active.

userProfileData.description: Details of UserProfile which a Contact Center administrator has configured for the user.This is an optional object, returned only when the endpoint 'Get User along with profile by ID' is invoked.

userProfileGranularAccessData.description: Details of UserProfile which a Contact Center administrator has configured for the user.This is an optional object, returned only when the endpoint 'Get User along with profile by ID' is invoked.

imiUserCreated.description: Specify whether or not the corresponding user is created in IMI.

preferredSupervisorTeamId.description: The teamId to look for to load the desktop layout when a supervisor logs in to desktop.

systemDefault.description: Indicates whether the created resource is system created or not

userLevelBurnoutInclusion.description: User level burnout inclusion type. Used only when Agent inclusion is set to 'Specific Agents' at the org level Agent Wellbeing>Burnout config.

userLevelAutoCSATInclusion.description: User level AutoCSAT inclusion type. Used only when Agent inclusion is set to 'Specific Agents' at the org level Cisco AI Assistant>Auto CSAT config.

userLevelWellnessBreakReminders.description: User level Wellness break reminder type. If top level Agent burnout config has wellness break reminders enabled, this property determines if an Agent is enabled/disabled for receiving break reminders.

userLevelSummariesInclusion.description: User level Generated Summaries inclusion type. Used only when Generated Summaries is set to 'Specific Agents' at the org level Cisco AI Assistant>Generated Summaries.

queuesCount.description: The count of each type of Contact Service Queues that the user is assigned to.

skillProfileUpdatedBy.description: The ID of the user who last modified the skill profile

dynamicSkills.description: The list of dynamic skills associated with the user

dynamicSkillsLimitReached.description: Indicates if the user has reached the dynamic skills assignment limit. Present only if includeDynamicSkillsLimitReached=true is passed in the request.

dynamicSkillsUpdatedBy.description: The name of the user who last modified dynamic skills

dynamicSkillsUpdatedTime.description: The date when dynamic skills were last modified

dynamicSkillAssigned.description: Indicates if the user has the specified dynamic skill assigned. Present only if checkIfUserHasDynamicSkill=true and dynamicSkillId are provided in the request.

createdTime.description: This is the created time of the entity.

lastUpdatedTime.description: This is the updated time of the entity.

skillProfileUpdatedTime.description: The date when the skill profile was last modified
